node1.title: Mathematical Foundation
node1.script:
We begin with a formal axiomatic system. The goal is to derive all physical phenomena from minimal assumptions.

Definition 1.1: Spation is defined as an incompressible, inviscid superfluid medium. The divergence of velocity equals zero—incompressibility. Viscosity equals zero—no drag.

Definition 1.2: Displacement is the volume ratio delta-V over V-zero, where matter excludes spation from its occupied region.

Axiom A1: The pressure field Pi at any point x equals the integral over solid angle of CMB intensity times one minus the occlusion function E.

Axiom A2: The displacement density rho-disp is non-negative and localized, representing matter distribution.

Axiom A3: The occlusion function E of x and n-hat lies in the interval zero to one, satisfying geometric visibility constraints.

Axiom A4: Force equals negative displacement volume times the gradient of pressure. This is the fundamental dynamical law.

Theorem 2.1: From axioms A1 through A4, the Master Displacement Equation follows:

Nabla dot bracket K-bulk nabla delta close bracket equals negative kappa rho-disp times parenthesis one minus E close parenthesis.

Proof: We establish the constitutive relation from A1, identify the source term from A2, incorporate occlusion reduction from A3, and derive the field equation from conservation and A4.

Q.E.D.

The consistency and independence of this axiomatic system can be formally verified. We proceed to applications.

node2.title: Derivation Tree (Complete)
node2.hook: Each derivation chain maintains dimensional consistency and logical rigor.
node2.script:
We now present the complete derivation tree, demonstrating how each physical law emerges from the Master Equation.

Branch 1: Coulomb's Law.

In the limit where occlusion E approaches zero, the Master Equation reduces to the standard Poisson equation for electrostatics. The coupling constant emerges as:

k-Coulomb equals 1 over 4 pi epsilon-zero, where epsilon-zero is derived from K-bulk and spation properties.

No fine-tuning. The value 8.99 times 10 to the 9 Newton meters squared per Coulomb squared emerges geometrically.

Branch 2: Newtonian Gravity.

In the limit where E approaches 1 minus eta, with eta much less than 1, we recover the inverse-square law. The effective gravitational coupling emerges as:

G-effective equals eta times K-bulk over c-squared.

Note: G is not fundamental. It is a derived quantity, scale-dependent, emerging from occlusion geometry.

Branch 3: Atomic Spectra.

The k-law v equals c over k times square root of R over r, with k equals 137.036 for hydrogen, yields the Rydberg formula directly. Error: less than 0.1 percent.

Branch 4: Relativistic Effects.

High-velocity effects emerge from pressure field distortion. No spacetime curvature is invoked. Perihelion precession, gravitational redshift, and light bending all derive from pressure geometry.

Each branch is independently verifiable against experimental data.

node3.title: Validation Protocol
node3.hook: Science requires falsifiability. Here is how SDT can be tested—and refuted.
node3.script:
Science requires falsifiability. A theory that cannot be wrong is not a theory—it is dogma.

Here is how SDT can be tested, and refuted.

Benchmark Protocol: We define 24 specific predictions, each compared against authoritative experimental data. No curve fitting. No adjustable parameters. The geometry determines the prediction.

Current Status: 16 benchmarks certified with error less than 1 percent. 6 under investigation. 2 pending experimental verification.

Falsification Criteria:

Criterion 1: If any benchmark shows persistent error greater than 5 percent after systematic uncertainty analysis, the axioms require revision.

Criterion 2: If electron structure measurements at 10 to the minus 22 meter resolution reveal point-like behavior, the toroidal model fails.

Criterion 3: If dark matter particles are unambiguously detected with properties matching Lambda-CDM predictions, the eclipse effect is insufficient.

Criterion 4: If gravitational effects are observed that require spacetime curvature beyond pressure gradient explanation, axiom A4 is incomplete.

We invite peer review. We welcome criticism. Science advances through rigorous testing, not faith.

The data are publicly available. Verify for yourself.
